hints.title: Pair Comparison Obstacle
hints.text: Comparing every pair of numbers takes quadratic time. As you scan the array one number at a time, what property would indicate you have encountered an element previously?

hints.title: Lookup Collection for Visited Values
hints.text: Store each visited value in a lookup collection. If the current number is already in the collection, a duplicate is found immediately.

hints.title: Single-Pass Traversal with Set
hints.text: Iterate through the numbers while tracking visited values in a set. For each number, check if it has already been observed. If so, return true. If the loop completes without finding any duplicate, return false.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: length of nums array (1 <= N <= 10^5)
complexity.notes: Single pass through nums with O(1) average set lookups and insertions.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking every pair with nested loops requires O(N^2) time. For N = 10^5, this requires up to 5 * 10^9 operations, far exceeding the 1-second timeout on LeetCode.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Using O(N) auxiliary space in a set or hash table achieves O(N) linear time compared to O(N log N) sorting with O(1) extra space or O(N^2) brute force.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Immediate identification of the set/hash table approach, early return on first duplicate seen, and awareness of the alternative O(N log N) in-place sorting tradeoff when memory is constrained.
